name: cache-keep-warm
description: Shows how long your session's prompt cache stays warm, and can keep it warm in the background while you are away

title_mark.title: Mark the session title
title_mark.description: While keep-warm is on, put a green dot in front of the session's title in the desktop app's session list

default_on.title: On in new sessions
default_on.description: Turn keep-warm on in every new session, as if you ran /keepwarm on. Each session still stops by itself after the set number of pings in a row

max_pings.title: Pings in a row
max_pings.description: Without a stop time, keep-warm stops itself after this many pings in a row, one about every 52 minutes (1 to 20; 8 is about 7 hours). Any real turn in the conversation starts the count over
